contracts.protection_obligation: Before PackageManager.install_package commits a pip/uv package installation via subprocess.run, the requested package name must pass the PackageManager.is_whitelisted check against the blocked/safe/whitelisted lists loaded from package_config.toml; packages not on the safe/whitelisted allowlists (with blocked entries hard-refused) must be refused without invoking the install subprocess, so that installation into the Python execution environment is committed only for allowed packages on the auto-install path invoked from executor.execute_code's ImportError retry loop. (Merges first-phase and second-phase reviewer wordings of the same gate-before-commit obligation.)
